quarterly_data.signal: Full-year 2025 total revenues per the 10-K were $12,001.3 million, up 9% from $11,020.1 million in 2024, primarily due to continued strong demand for TRIKAFTA/KAFTRIO and contributions from the launches of ALYFTREK, JOURNAVX and CASGEVY. TRIKAFTA/KAFTRIO was $10,312.7 million (+1%), ALYFTREK $837.8 million and other product revenues $820.1 million (+5%); U.S. revenue was $7,548.6 million (+13%) and ex-U.S. $4,452.7 million (+3%). Cost of sales as a percentage of net product revenues decreased from 13.9% in 2024 to 13.8% in 2025 as a result of a lower overall royalty rate for CF medicines, partially offset by changes in product mix and investments in network expansion and manufacturing process improvements, and AIPR&D was $133.0 million. Third-party contract manufacturers, including some based in China, perform different parts of Vertex's manufacturing process.
